description: Header file defining the NetworkManagerClient class for managing network interfaces, WiFi, and WPS operations via D-Bus in a Gnome environment.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: Singleton class providing network management functionalities such as interface configuration, WiFi operations, and WPS handling.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkManagerClient.

methods.name: getAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the specified interface as primary.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for a given interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Gets the current primary network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Gets the default network interface.

methods.name: getInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if a specified interface is enabled.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP settings for an interface.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Lists known WiFi SSIDs.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Gets information about the currently connected WiFi SSID.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a WiFi SSID to the known list.

methods.name: removeKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Removes a WiFi SSID from the known list.

methods.name: startWifiScan
methods.description: Initiates a WiFi scan.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if WiFi scan was performed recently.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information for an interface.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a WiFi network.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from current WiFi network.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a known WiFi connection.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves current WiFi state.

methods.name: getWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Gets WiFi signal quality metrics.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Starts WPS process.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Stops WPS process.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the device hostname.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnectionsConfig
methods.description: Modifies default connection configurations.

methods.name: wpsProcess
methods.description: Internal method to handle WPS process.

methods.name: getMatchingSSIDInfo
methods.description: Finds matching SSID info for WPS.

methods.name: isActiveApSameAsWps
methods.description: Checks if active AP matches WPS SSID.
